name: ILLUSTRATIVE Centres Model
heading: ILLUSTRATIVE Growth Model
sub: Fictional progression model. In the planned expansion, centres only advance when local demand and learning quality are independently demonstrated.

phases.name: Circle
phases.summary: One or two classroom pods operating in a shared local hall or partner space.
phases.liveExample: Chamba classroom on Floor G today operates in this lean, focused format.
phases.prerequisites: Local guide who knows every student; verified demand for foundational tracks.
phases.advancementGate: Stable enrollment and consistent unassisted learning gains across five days a week.

phases.name: Library
phases.summary: Adding Floor 1 Knowledge Commons for quiet independent reading and reference.
phases.liveExample: Planned for Chamba as soon as enough cardholders subscribe.
phases.prerequisites: Dedicated reading room; curated reference collection; active paper club.
phases.advancementGate: Community reader card subscriptions cover ongoing room maintenance.

phases.name: Campus
phases.summary: Full three-floor gurukul integrating learning, quiet study, and resident builders who teach.
phases.liveExample: Long-term vision for Chamba once real founders commit to mentoring.
phases.prerequisites: Established Learning Commons and Knowledge Commons floors.
phases.advancementGate: Funded purely from operating revenue with no outside money until five to six centres.
